en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a public square taken from beneath a portico with a series of large arches. The square is surrounded by modernist buildings typical of early to mid-20th century European architecture. A prominent sign on one building reads 'Giuseppe Niccolini', indicative of Italian language and possibly a historic business or store.
